description: Stupid-simple pan-seared broccolini with garlic — one skillet, five minutes of prep, tender-crisp and lightly charred. Mild enough for kids.
name: Simple Pan Broccolini
recipeInstructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the broccolini and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 4-5 minutes until bright green and starting to char.
Add the garlic (and red pepper flakes, if using) and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the water, cover, and steam 2-3 minutes until the stems are tender-crisp.
Uncover and cook off any remaining liquid. Serve immediately.
